mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_invites i WHERE i.uuid = d.invitation_uuid AND i.organization_uuid = d.organization_uuid AND i.status = 'pending' AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at = d.expires_at AND i.expires_at > clock_timestamp())
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_admin_invite_deliveries d SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = now() WHERE d.status IN ('pending', 'sending', 'failed') AND NOT

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT d.uuid FROM platform_admin_invite_deliveries d WHERE AND (d.status = 'pending' OR (d.status = 'failed' AND d.attempts < 5 AND d.updated_at < now() - interval '1 minute') OR (d.status = 'sending' AND d.updated_at < now() - interval '2 minutes')) ORDER BY d.created_at, d.uuid LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE platform_admin_invite_deliveries d SET status = 'sending', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now() FROM candidate c WHERE d.uuid = c.uuid RETURNING d.uuid, d.organization_uuid, d.recipient, d.expires_at, d.attempts
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_admin_invite_deliveries d WHERE d.uuid = #{deliveryUUID} AND d.attempts = #{attempts} AND d.status = 'sending' AND ) AS ready
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_admin_invite_deliveries SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{deliveryUUID} AND attempts = #{attempts} AND status = 'sending'
